servicesSummary: Innovation Norway (aka Innovasjon Norge) Provided travel information and services as well as promotional work. Answered written, telephone and email requests from travel trade. Hosted travel webinars to inform travel trade about opportunities in Norway, updated our website, www.visitnorway.com and posted on our Facebook,/Visitnorway and Instagram/visitnorway pages.
